MASK32 = 0xffffffff
MASK8 = 0xff

def expand(k):
    k &= 0xfffff
    return (k ^ ((k << 16) & MASK32) ^ ((k * 12345) & MASK32)) & MASK32

def rotl8(x, n):
    x &= MASK8
    return ((x << n) | (x >> (8-n))) & MASK8

def g_function(a, b, x):
    temp = (a + b + x) & MASK8
    return rotl8(temp, 2)

def f_function(v):
    v &= MASK32
    x = [(v >> (8*i)) & MASK8 for i in range(4)]
    y2 = g_function(x[3] ^ x[2], x[1] ^ x[0], 1)
    y3 = g_function(x[3], y2, 0)
    y1 = g_function(x[1] ^ x[0], y2, 0)
    y0 = g_function(x[0], y1, 1)
    return (y0 | (y1 << 8) | (y2 << 16) | (y3 << 24)) & MASK32

def set_keys(seeds):
    return [expand(s) for s in seeds]

def encrypt_big(p, seeds):
    keys = set_keys(seeds)
    L = (p >> 32) & MASK32
    R = p & MASK32
    R ^= L
    for K in keys:
        mixed = f_function(R ^ K)
        oldR = R
        R = L ^ mixed
        L = oldR
    L ^= R
    return ((R << 32) | L) & MASK32

def decrypt_big(c, seeds):
    keys = set_keys(seeds)
    L = c & MASK32
    R = (c >> 32) & MASK32
    L ^= R
    for K in reversed(keys):
        temp = L
        L = R
        mixed = f_function(temp ^ K)
        R = temp
        L ^= mixed
    R ^= L
    return ((L << 32) | R) & MASK32
